verdict.rationale: RustDesk is a remote desktop product. Such a product could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, for example over audit logs or session data, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any AI-generated insights, suggestions, or analysis feature. The closest data features are audit logs and a web console, which are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
